title: Missing Strict-Transport-Security Header
description: The HTTP response does not include the Strict-Transport-Security (HSTS) security header.
remediation: Configure your web server to include 'Strict-Transport-Security: max-age=31536000; includeSubDomains' in HTTP response headers.

evidence.snippet_or_description:
HTTP/1.1 200 OK
Server: nginx
Content-Type: text/html; charset=utf-8
(Missing HSTS header)
